The '''T-40 Flitter''' was a model of [[Airspeeder/Legends|flitter]] built by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were armed with a double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] for police and paramilitary use.<ref name="ML" />

60 were employed at the main [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for security in the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ML" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
T-40 Flitters appear in [[West End Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Mission to Lianna]]''.<ref name="ML" />
